scope: Proposition 4.3 of the manuscript “An explicit failure of complex affine-space cancellation” (preprints/An-explicit-failure-of-complex-affine-space-cancellation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 047 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 91a1a2f28c960cba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let D0 be a homogeneous locally nilpotent derivation of G of valuation degree shift j. There is a locally nilpotent derivation e D of e G restricting to D0 on G, with fiber weight zero and valuation degree shift j. If D0 ̸= 0, then e D ̸= 0.
